params.body:
## Why

`ownstock/_tabs/general.blade.php` was the last screen of the vehicle sheet still built on the
Bootstrap grid: ~46 `form-control` fields, ~20 `input-group`s and a `row` / `col-md-6 col-lg-4`
layout, ~557 lines. The panes around it (prices, inspections, options, extras in #251 and #252,
the Stocklist modals in #253, the offer and order partials in #254) already speak the `ui-`
vocabulary, so this tab was the odd one out: two form idioms on the same page, and every rule in
`refresh.css` that propped up the old markup had to stay alive for this one file.

It is the main tab, used by the classic create/edit form and by the Livewire sheet
(`LIVEWIRE_VEHICLE_FORM`, on on staging), so the migration had to be behaviour-neutral in both.

## What, per section

- **Owner (export only)** — `input-group` + append button to `x-ui.affix` with a
  `ui-affix-add ui-affix-button`, the same relation picker the order and offer modals use. The two
  hidden inputs (`original_owner_id`, `relation_name`) moved just above the affix; they post the same.
- **Vehicle data** — one `ui-form-grid ui-form-grid--3` of `ui-field`s instead of a `row` of
  `form-group col-md-6 col-lg-4`. Units (km, kw, pk, cc, kg, mm) are `x-ui.affix suffix="…"`.
  `cylinder_capacity` stays a plain `<input>`: its `onchange` carries the fiscal-pk table as raw
  JSON, which does not belong in a component tag. Its stray `($lw)` attribute — never valid HTML —
  is gone; the `wire:model.live` is untouched.
- **Export block** — `#for_export_vehicle` keeps its id and its `d-none` condition; only the
  `col-12` wrapper class is gone. `export/form.blade.php` itself is untouched (it is also used by
  the export create modal) and its own `.row` still aligns with the parent's content edge.
- **Taxes** — six `€` fields as `x-ui.affix prefix="€"` in a `ui-form-grid--3`. The
  `own_vehicle_only` class and its `d-none` condition sit on the same elements as before.
- **Warranty** — the `nav-tabs` + `tab-content` either/or switch becomes the shared
  `ui-warranty-box` / `ui-warranty-tabs` / `ui-warranty-pane` that the offer and order modals
  already use, driven by the same Alpine `wtab` state and the same `wire:click` / `onclick`
  handlers. `x-cloak` on the panes so neither flashes before Alpine decides.
- **Spoticar, location, showroom** — the radios and the checkbox keep their names, ids,
  `icheckbox_flat-blue` and `spoticar-radio` hooks and their hidden `0` companions; the location
  selects keep `ui-add-btn` next to them in a flex row instead of a nested `row`/`col`.
- **Description** — the AI block is unchanged apart from `ui-button ui-button--primary` for its
  button; the two textareas sit in a `ui-form-grid--2`. The AI modal keeps its Bootstrap shell
  (modals are a separate migration); only its two footer buttons became `ui-button`.

`refresh.css`: removed the rules that only styled the markup this PR replaced — the
`#warranty_or_mileage_tabs` nav-tabs block and its `.tab-content` panel, `#warranty_tab
.input-group`, both `.ui-edit .input-group-text` rules and the `.input-group:has(…)` width caps.
The width cap that kept number fields readable now reads `.ui-edit .ui-affix:has(> span.ui-affix-add)`,
which covers the same fields plus the ones the options pane already migrated, and leaves an affix
with a button in it (relation picker, warranty months) at full width. `.ui-form-field-hint` got
`display: block`, which `form-text` used to provide.

## JS hooks kept

Every id, name, class and handler the page scripts select on: `own_vehicle_only` (including the
`.own_vehicle_only.d-none :input` validate-ignore), `export_vehicle_only`, `intern_number_input`,
`for_export_vehicle`, `relation_name` / `relation_name_error`, `color-code-required`,
`chassis_number` / `chassis_number_warning`, `spoticar-radio`, `showroom_vehicle`,
`location_id_select`, `pick_up_location_id_select`, `ai_generated_text`, `ai_text`,
`ai_include_own`, `price_input`, `required`, `text-right`, `vehicle_description`,
`vehicle_own_description`, `custom.autofillHorsePower/Kilowatt/TAXpk`, and every `wire:model`.

Two deliberate touch-ups, both stated here because they are the only behavioural deltas:

- `structurize.js` covers the spinner box with `closest('.ui-field, .form-group')` — the
  description fields are `ui-field` now. Both spellings still work.
- A handful of `<label for="…">` values that pointed at nothing or at a duplicate id
  (`for="mileage"` on the kW, PK and cc fields; `for="weight"` on width/height/length) now point at
  their own field. The unit `<span>`s lost their duplicate ids in the same move. This only affects
  the label lookup in the error summary and the API debug label, both for the better.

## Screenshots

`tw-general-{before,after}-{1280,390}.png` (classic form) and
`tw-general-{before,after}-{classic,lw}-{1280,390}.png` (both modes), rendered through the test
kernel and Playwright. The tab reads the same in both modes at both widths and is noticeably
shorter: 4486 px against 4764 px at 1280 in the classic form, 4112 against 4394 in the Livewire
sheet.

## Checked

- `php artisan view:cache` plus `php -l` on every compiled view: clean.
- `npm run build`: clean (`public/build` stays untracked).
- `phpunit --filter='SmokeTest|StylesheetSyntaxTest|UiApiUsageTest|ClassReferencesResolveTest|VehicleForm|Vehicle|OwnStock'`:
  225 tests, 1126 assertions, green.
- Full suite: the only failures are `RemoveBackgroundTest` (fails on `main` too in this
  environment) and `BuildStampTest` (reads `.git/refs/heads/…`, which an attached git worktree does
  not have; passes on a normal clone).
- No `form-control`, `input-group`, `form-group`, `row` or `col-*` left in the file.

The diff is one pass over the file (678 changed lines, 84 fewer than before). Splitting it in two
would have meant shipping a half-Bootstrap outer grid in between, which is worse to review than a
single coherent rewrite of the same fields in the same order.
params.title: Vehicle sheet: the general tab off Bootstrap forms
